newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Snows slow movement.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Snows slow movement.

text.p: Heavy snows slowed movement of dark northern spring wheat Monday at locations across the upper Midwest, U.S. grain dealers said.
Dealers in Minnesota and North Dakota reported that blizzard-like conditions had virtually halted movement over the weekend and again Monday.
"Most of my workers are at home today," one dealer in eastern North Dakota said.
But in central Montana and points west, where weather conditions were milder, dealers reported that business was active Monday.
Meanwhile, cash bids for dark northern spring were mostly higher in line with a rise in March futures at the Minneapolis Grain Exchange.
